description:
## [1.6.1](https://github.com/AltF4G0x/consumer-clarity/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1) (2026-11-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Demote unrated restaurants after rated entries ([b028afd](https://github.com/AltF4G0x/consumer-clarity/commit/b028afd3dec2932398d9723e0c27575e889aa637))

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Clears Android's secure-window flag so screenshots and screen recording are allowed.

patches.name: Block WebView content access
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from opening Android content URLs.

patches.name: Block WebView file access
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from reading arbitrary file URLs.

patches.name: Block WebView mixed content
patches.description: Blocks insecure HTTP content from loading inside HTTPS WebView pages.

patches.name: Block WebView network images
patches.description: Reduces WebView data usage by blocking network-loaded images.

patches.name: Block WebView popup windows
patches.description: Prevents WebView JavaScript from opening additional windows automatically.

patches.name: Block cross-origin WebView file URLs
patches.description: Blocks file URLs from reading other files or making cross-origin requests in WebView pages.

patches.name: Block third-party WebView cookies
patches.description: Blocks cross-site cookies inside Talabat's in-app WebView pages.

patches.name: Consistent restaurant and review sorting
patches.description: Sorts restaurants by organic placement, rating and ID, and reviews by date and ID. Requires Talabat 14.4.0 (2368) on ARM64.

patches.name: Disable Adjust install referrer
patches.description: Disables Adjust's install-referrer receiver without changing normal deep links.

patches.name: Disable Analytics upload services
patches.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement upload services and its receiver.

patches.name: Disable Bluetooth access
patches.description: Removes Bluetooth scan, connect, advertise, and legacy Bluetooth permissions.

patches.name: Disable Braze promotional push
patches.description: Disables Braze's push receiver. Talabat's separate Firebase order-messaging service is unchanged.

patches.name: Disable Firebase session reporting
patches.description: Disables Firebase's session lifecycle reporting service. Crash and analytics controls remain separate.

patches.name: Disable Google Tag Manager
patches.description: Disables the Tag Manager background service used for marketing measurement.

patches.name: Disable Google telemetry transport
patches.description: Disables Google's background telemetry upload scheduler and alarm receivers.

patches.name: Disable Huawei ads identifier
patches.description: Removes Huawei's advertising-identifier service declaration while leaving Huawei login and maps intact.

patches.name: Disable NFC access
patches.description: Removes NFC access from Talabat.

patches.name: Disable Play license gate
patches.description: Skips the pairip license check and its repeated scheduler so the modified app can start without Google Play licensing. Other Google-dependent features are unchanged.

patches.name: Disable Sentry ANR profiling
patches.description: Sets Sentry's ANR profiling sample rate to zero.

patches.name: Disable Sentry ANR reports
patches.description: Disables Sentry application-not-responding reports.

patches.name: Disable Sentry ANR thread dumps
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching thread dumps to ANR reports.

patches.name: Disable Sentry SurfaceView replay
patches.description: Prevents Sentry replay from capturing SurfaceView content.

patches.name: Disable Sentry app-start tracing
patches.description: Disables automatic startup and activity lifecycle performance traces.

patches.name: Disable Sentry breadcrumbs
patches.description: Prevents application-supplied breadcrumbs from being recorded by Sentry.

patches.name: Disable Sentry cache tracing
patches.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for cache operations.

patches.name: Disable Sentry crash reports
patches.description: Suppresses Sentry events, exceptions, messages, and user-feedback reports while returning an empty event ID.

patches.name: Disable Sentry crash screenshots
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching screenshots to crash events.

patches.name: Disable Sentry database tracing
patches.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for database transactions.

patches.name: Disable Sentry device context
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from collecting additional device context.

patches.name: Disable Sentry error replay
patches.description: Disables Sentry replay capture associated with errors.

patches.name: Disable Sentry frame tracking
patches.description: Disables Sentry frame-rate and rendering performance collection.

patches.name: Disable Sentry full-display tracing
patches.description: Disables Sentry's time-to-full-display performance traces.

patches.name: Disable Sentry historical ANRs
patches.description: Disables Sentry reports for historical application-not-responding events.

patches.name: Disable Sentry interaction breadcrumbs
patches.description: Prevents taps and other user interactions from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.

patches.name: Disable Sentry interaction tracing
patches.description: Disables Sentry performance traces built from user interactions.

patches.name: Disable Sentry lifecycle breadcrumbs
patches.description: Disables activity, application, and component lifecycle breadcrumbs.

patches.name: Disable Sentry logcat collection
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from turning logcat messages into breadcrumbs or Sentry logs. Logcat output itself is unchanged.

patches.name: Disable Sentry native crash preload
patches.description: Disables Sentry's native crash-handler preload provider.

patches.name: Disable Sentry native reporting
patches.description: Disables Sentry's native NDK integration.

patches.name: Disable Sentry network breadcrumbs
patches.description: Prevents network changes from becoming Sentry breadcrumbs.

patches.name: Disable Sentry performance V2
patches.description: Disables Sentry's second-generation automatic performance collection.

patches.name: Disable Sentry performance traces
patches.description: Sets Sentry's performance trace sample rate to zero.

patches.name: Disable Sentry profiling
patches.description: Sets Sentry's profiling sample rate to zero.

patches.name: Disable Sentry queue tracing
patches.description: Disables Sentry performance traces for queue operations.

patches.name: Disable Sentry raw tombstones
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching raw native tombstone data.

patches.name: Disable Sentry replay network bodies
patches.description: Prevents Sentry replay from capturing network request and response bodies.

patches.name: Disable Sentry root reporting
patches.description: Disables Sentry's root-status checks and reporting.

patches.name: Disable Sentry session replay
patches.description: Displays no Sentry session-replay capture. This is separate from crash screenshots.

patches.name: Disable Sentry startup performance
patches.description: Disables Sentry's automatic startup performance provider.

patches.name: Disable Sentry storage context
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from collecting external-storage context.

patches.name: Disable Sentry system breadcrumbs
patches.description: Disables system-event breadcrumbs and their extra device details.

patches.name: Disable Sentry tombstone reports
patches.description: Disables Sentry tombstone collection and historical tombstone reporting.

patches.name: Disable Sentry view hierarchy capture
patches.description: Prevents Sentry from attaching the app's view hierarchy to events.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs activity history
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording lifecycle and touch activity.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs console logs
patches.description: Prevents application log messages from being added to Shake Bugs reports.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs crash reports
patches.description: Suppresses Shake Bugs error handling, silent reports, and crash-report enablement.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs identity tracking
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from receiving user IDs, metadata, and push tokens.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs initialization
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from starting. Other Shake Bugs switches are unnecessary when this is selected.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs network inspection
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording network requests and responses.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs notification history
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from recording notification events.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs screen recording
patches.description: Disables Shake Bugs' foreground screen-recording service.

patches.name: Disable Shake Bugs user feedback
patches.description: Disables Shake Bugs' user-feedback collection.

patches.name: Disable WebView DOM storage
patches.description: Disables WebView DOM storage. Some signed-in WebView pages may lose local state.

patches.name: Disable WebView background audio
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from continuing audio in the background.

patches.name: Disable WebView cache
patches.description: Disables WebView caching to reduce retained browsing data. Network usage may increase.

patches.name: Disable WebView database storage
patches.description: Disables the legacy WebView database API and its stored data.

patches.name: Disable WebView form saving
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from saving form data.

patches.name: Disable WebView geolocation
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView pages from requesting device location through the browser API.

patches.name: Disable background location
patches.description: Removes background-location access. Foreground delivery addresses and order tracking can still work.

patches.name: Disable camera access
patches.description: Removes camera permission. QR scanning, document capture, and profile-photo capture will be unavailable.

patches.name: Disable country geofence notifications
patches.description: Disables the receiver that reacts to country-boundary location changes.

patches.name: Disable high-rate sensors
patches.description: Removes access to high-sampling-rate motion sensors used by diagnostics and gesture detection.

patches.name: Disable legacy external storage
patches.description: Removes legacy broad external-storage read and write permissions. App-owned media sharing remains separate.

patches.name: Disable microphone access
patches.description: Removes microphone permission and prevents in-app audio recording.

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Removes Android's screen-capture detection permission. This does not prevent Android screenshots.

patches.name: Disable system overlays
patches.description: Removes Talabat's ability to draw over other apps.

patches.name: Enable WebView safe browsing
patches.description: Requests Android Safe Browsing checks for in-app WebView pages.

patches.name: Force dark WebView content
patches.description: Requests dark rendering for supported in-app WebView pages. Flutter screens are unchanged.

patches.name: Hide Braze content cards
patches.description: Disables Braze's promotional content-card activity.

patches.name: Hide Braze in-app popups
patches.description: Prevents Braze promotional in-app messages from being queued or displayed. Functional app dialogs and push notifications are unchanged.

patches.name: Hide Shake Bugs chat notifications
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from displaying support-chat notifications.

patches.name: Hide Shake Bugs introduction
patches.description: Suppresses Shake Bugs' introductory message.

patches.name: Hide Shake Bugs report UI
patches.description: Prevents Shake Bugs from opening its feedback and bug-report interface.

patches.name: Home settings shortcut
patches.description: Adds a draggable Clarity button to Talabat's home screen for direct access to the patch control center.

patches.name: Keep screen on
patches.description: Keeps the screen awake while Talabat's main activity is visible.

patches.name: Link safety preview
patches.description: Shows the destination before opening a link, with Open, Share, Copy, and Cancel actions.

patches.name: Open links in default browser
patches.description: Routes links that would open in Talabat's in-app WebView to the default browser. Can be toggled in Consumer Clarity settings.

patches.name: Preferred app language
patches.description: Adds System Default, English, Arabic, and Kurdish language choices for Talabat's interface.

patches.name: Reduce analytics tracking
patches.description: Disables confirmed Firebase, Adjust, Perseus and Braze event logging paths without blocking restaurant, checkout or order-tracking network requests.

patches.name: Remove ad attribution access
patches.description: Removes access to Android Privacy Sandbox attribution reporting.

patches.name: Remove ad services identifier access
patches.description: Removes access to Android Privacy Sandbox advertising identifiers.

patches.name: Remove advertising ID permission
patches.description: Removes Android's advertising-identifier permission. Talabat can no longer request the Google advertising ID.

patches.name: Require WebView media gesture
patches.description: Prevents in-app WebView media from starting without a user gesture. Manual playback remains available.

patches.name: Restaurant rating filter
patches.description: Adds a minimum-rating filter for restaurant listings, including 4.0 and 4.5 stars.

patches.name: Review content filter
patches.description: Adds minimum-rating and reviews-with-text filters without changing review content.

patches.name: Settings backup and restore
patches.description: Adds JSON export and import for patch preferences without account or order data.

patches.name: Settings search
patches.description: Adds a search field to filter patch controls by name, description, or category.

patches.name: Share links
patches.description: Opens Android's share sheet for links instead of displaying them in Talabat's WebView.

patches.name: Text size
patches.description: Adds independent text scaling from 85% to 130% without changing device-wide font settings.

patches.name: Use incognito WebView pages
patches.description: Requests private browsing behavior for in-app WebView pages. Signed-in pages may stop working.
